title: Auseinandersetzung im Volkspark – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht

extraction.summaryEn: During an argument in Volkspark Hasenheide, a man was stabbed several times with a knife, and a 48-year-old who came to help was also stabbed. The 60-year-old is in life-threatening condition, and the 48-year-old in critical condition, and the 7th Homicide Commission is investigating.
